title: Pinnacle
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 10.1-inch touchscreen, voice command, Amazon Alexa built-in; Harman Kardon premium audio standard
adasStandard: All Advanced SafetyTec features standard on Pinnacle: forward-collision warning with pedestrian/cyclist detection, automatic emergency braking, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go, lane-departure warning, lane-keeping assist, blind-spot monitoring with rear cross-path detection, ParkSense front and rear park assist, automated parking, rear cross-traffic alert, surround-view 360 camera. Sources: https://www.edmunds.com/chrysler/pacifica/2025/plug-in-hybrid/
adasOptional: All ADAS features are standard on Pinnacle. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/chrysler/pacifica/2025/plug-in-hybrid/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard backup camera with dynamic gridlines on 10.1-inch Uconnect 5 touchscreen. Pinnacle includes higher-resolution camera per dealer marketing. Source: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/chrysler/pacifica-hybrid
sideViewCameraNotes: 360-degree surround-view camera standard. No Honda LaneWatch-style dedicated side-view camera. No trailer-view camera. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/chrysler/pacifica/2025/plug-in-hybrid/
subscriptionFeatures: Chrysler Connect: remote start, door lock/unlock, vehicle locator, SOS Call — 12-month trial then paid subscription. Pinnacle includes Harman Kardon premium audio (not subscription-locked), quilted Nappa leather, second-row lumbar pillows, Berber carpet, Ultra Console — none of these are subscription-gated. SiriusXM and Wi-Fi hotspot separate. Source: https://www.chrysler.com/uconnect/connectivity.html
drmNotes: Vehicle operates fully without internet. Chrysler Connect 12-month trial, then subscription required for remote features. Source: https://www.driveuconnect.com/sirius-xm-guardian.html
killSwitchNotes: No dedicated impaired-driving kill-switch hardware. Source: https://www.cbtnews.com/controversial-kill-switch-mandate-lives-on/
knownIssues: Same as Select: in-car electronics glitches, 12V battery drain, hybrid-system error codes. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/chrysler/pacifica-hybrid/
recalls: Same recall exposure. Check open recalls at https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls by VIN.

title: Select
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 10.1-inch touchscreen, voice command, Amazon Alexa built-in
adasStandard: Standard: forward-collision warning with pedestrian/cyclist detection, automatic emergency braking, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go, lane-departure warning, lane-keeping assist, blind-spot monitoring with rear cross-path detection, ParkSense rear park assist, rear cross-traffic alert. Sources: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/chrysler/pacifica-hybrid ; https://www.edmunds.com/chrysler/pacifica/2025/plug-in-hybrid/
adasOptional: Optional: surround-view 360-degree camera (part of Advanced SafetyTec Group), front and rear parking sensors, automated parking. Sources: https://www.edmunds.com/chrysler/pacifica/2025/plug-in-hybrid/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard backup camera with dynamic gridlines on the 10.1-inch Uconnect 5 touchscreen. Resolution not officially specified but generally rated adequate by reviewers; not multi-angle by default on Select. Source: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/chrysler/pacifica-hybrid
sideViewCameraNotes: No side-view camera (no Honda LaneWatch-style mirror feed) on Select trim. 360-degree surround view available only via the optional Advanced SafetyTec package. No trailer-view camera. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/chrysler/pacifica/2025/plug-in-hybrid/
subscriptionFeatures: Chrysler Connect (Connected Services): remote start, door lock/unlock, vehicle locator, stolen-vehicle assistance, SOS Call — 12-month trial, then ~$15-25/month or annual subscription. SiriusXM satellite radio: separate subscription after trial. Wi-Fi hotspot: separate data plan. No subscription-locked physical hardware (heated seats, ADAS, performance are not gated). Source: https://www.chrysler.com/uconnect/connectivity.html
drmNotes: Vehicle operates fully without internet. Connected Services (Chrysler Connect / former SiriusXM Guardian) ships with a 12-month trial — remote start, door lock/unlock, vehicle locator, and SOS Call require an active subscription after trial. Local features (drive, climate, radio, wired CarPlay) continue working when subscription lapses. OTA updates pushed via Uconnect. Sources: https://www.driveuconnect.com/sirius-xm-guardian.html ; https://www.pacificaforums.com/threads/uconnect-access-siriusxm-guardian-annoyances-and-alternative.24321/
killSwitchNotes: No dedicated impaired-driving kill-switch hardware. Chrysler has made no commitment to specific HALT Act compliance technology; NHTSA's federal rule has not been finalized. Sources: https://www.cbtnews.com/controversial-kill-switch-mandate-lives-on/
knownIssues: Pacifica Hybrid has historically had below-average reliability per Consumer Reports — issues reported include in-car electronics glitches (Uconnect freezes/reboots), 12V battery drain when Connected Services in standby, occasional hybrid-system error codes requiring dealer software updates, and brake-system shudder. First-gen 2017-2018 models had multiple fire-risk recalls largely addressed by software/hardware fixes. Sources: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/chrysler/pacifica-hybrid/ ; https://www.pacificaforums.com/
recalls: Pacifica Hybrid has had numerous recalls over its lifecycle (2017+) including hybrid-system overheating/fire risk (NHTSA 21V-650 and earlier), 12V battery sensor (22V-088 and similar), wheel-bearing/hub assemblies, and software-related items. The 2025 model year specifically has had recalls for hybrid-system fault codes and chime/cluster software updates. Check current open recalls at https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls by VIN.
stateIncentives: Varies by state. California Clean Vehicle Rebate Project (CVRP) ended for new applications in late 2023; replaced by Clean Cars 4 All for income-qualified residents. New York Drive Clean Rebate up to $500 (PHEV with <40 mi EV range). Colorado innovative motor vehicle credit ~$1,500 for PHEV. Check current state programs at https://afdc.energy.gov/laws/state
